description: Turns a form in the site's code into a Xodia form, the same way as Send to Xodia Forms in Xodia's Settings panel: it writes action, method="post", data-xodia-form, success and error text, a hidden spam field and the page field onto the form, adds the site helper, and makes the form's record (recipients: you, the member whose AI this is; the Turnstile check on for paid plans). Pick the form with index, line or match, or leave them out when the file has one form. Works on React (.tsx, .jsx) and plain HTML (.html) files. Keep the form's field names, keep or add a role="status" (or data-xodia-status) element for the answer, and never add an onSubmit or a mailto: action; a form with its own submit code is connected but flagged, so remove that code. Refused for a form that is already connected (form_already_connected), a file with no such form, other file types, and forms with no named fields. Saved at once, like every edit in Xodia; pushing to Git and publishing stay the user's. Recipients, Turnstile, notifications and webhooks are changed in Xodia.

branch.description: Optional branch; default the branch the workspace has open

file.description: The file the form is in, relative to the project root (src/pages/Contact.tsx, contact.html)

index.description: Which form in the file, 1 for the first. Give one of index, line or match, or none when the file has one form

line.description: A line of the form in the file (its <form> tag or any line inside it), as read_file numbers them

match.description: The form's data-xodia-connect value, id, name or aria-label, as written in the code

name.description: The form's name in Xodia (Contact form); default from the data-xodia-connect value or the file name

name: connect_form
title: Connect a form to Xodia Forms
